title: ID0429093-DC/Si-D/IT-[ MP / R9 170002560] Faulty plug
description:
Reported behavior/issue:
The charger
170002560 became 3 times partially operational with a faulty plug, between yesterday and today. We performed a Soft Reboot on Sifinity 3 times and then it returned operational. So it is operational now, but we would like to know if there are problems on the charger.
Can you check, please?
Thank you
Software Version: v6.1.3-0-gfb2eb75
OCPP Backend Connection: No

additional_info.subject: RE: ID0429093-DC/Si-D/IT-[ MP / R9 170002560] Faulty plug CRM:02679000348
additional_info.body:
Dear Filomena Carusone,
As checked in logs , The charger
was in faulty state because communication between PLC & Ecog was lost.
Rebooting the charger helped in restabling the communication after which it is currently in Healthy State.
If the Outlet again goes to fault state because of communication issue we will inform Service personnel for site visit .
We will keep the charger in observation for 1 day.
With best regards,
eMobility Tech Support Team -
Sunil Sharma
Please do not
change
the
subject of this Email when
replying
to it.

I checked this charger on SCB and no error appear.
For the moment i will close the ticket, but will monitor if any error occur again.
Bye,
Giuseppe
